'''Lusica Stynnix''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[junior officer]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] in the [[First Order Navy]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. As with other members of her generation, Stynnix was [[Reproduction|born]] in the [[First Order]], recruited into the [[First Order military|military]] at a young age, and became one of many subadults serving on the [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Supremacy]]''—the [[flagship]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]. Her [[First Order military uniforms|uniform]] included a rank [[Clothing|sash]] commemorating the [[Imperial Navy|service]] of [[Admiral]] [[Clyss Power]].

==Biography==
[[Lieutenant]] Lusica Stynnix was a [[junior officer]] in the [[First Order Navy]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Era|reign]], [[Sub-Adult Group|youth brigades]] were largely symbolic pledges of patriotism. The [[First Order]], however, recruited its youth, such as Stynnix, into actual [[First Order military|military service]].<ref name="TLJ VD" /> The First Order initially consisted of former [[Imperial Military|Imperial personnel]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref> Stynnix's generation, however, was raised since [[Reproduction|birth]] in the First Order fold.<ref name="TLJ VD" />

Stynnix served on the [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Supremacy]]''—the [[flagship]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]—by the [[time]] the First Order went to [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]] and [[the galaxy]]. As such, she joined a crew that numbered in the millions, many of whom were subadults like Stynnix and therefore too young for active combat deployment. Due to her role in the [[fleet]], Stynnix was assigned to the ''Supremacy''{{'s}} operations deck, where floors of open workstations bustled with efficient controllers.<ref name="TLJ VD" />

==Personality and traits==
Lusica Stynnix was a young [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who had [[Color|dark]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and fair skin. As with other members of her generation, Stynnix was fully [[Propaganda|indoctrinated]] into First Order [[Fascism|ideology]]. Therefore, she believed that only a strong, unflinching order was capable of bringing a chaotic [[galaxy]] under control. Like her subadult peers, Stynnix possessed a natural competitive streak and was driven to excel. Due to her upbringing, she was among the First Order's most loyal servants.<ref name="TLJ VD" />

==Equipment==
As a [[Navy|naval]] [[officer]], Stynnix wore a dark [[First Order military uniforms|First Order military uniform]] which included a [[Hat|cap]], black [[leather]] [[glove]]s, and two [[code cylinder]]s attached to her tunic. The [[First Order insignia]] was emblazoned on Stynnix's cap and her left [[Limb|arm]] [[Clothing|sleeve]] featured a [[Military rank|rank]] sash that commemorated [[Admiral]] [[Clyss Power]] of the [[Imperial Navy]]. Stynnix also carried a status [[datapad]] during her service in the operations division.<ref name="TLJ VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lusica Stynnix, portrayed by [[Jenn Murray]], first appeared in the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> She was first identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="TLJ VD" />
